title: Rockmeadow Equestrian Center
specs: Specializes in Hunter/Jumper Equitation and horsemanship
Offers a Step Up Share Program pairing riders with specific horses
Minimum age 7 years for weekly lessons; 4-6 years for Pony Classes
Riders must bring riding helmet and boots with heel; no bike or ski helmets allowed
No shorts; pants required for first lesson
Pony Classes are group classes for ages 4-6
includes: Use of helmets available to borrow (limited)
blurb: Guests learn to ride horses and care for them through lessons, classes, and camps. They offer beginner to advanced weekly riding lessons, pony classes for young children, and horsemanship classes. The center emphasizes horse safety, grooming, tacking up, and riding skills.
extraNote: 48 hours cancellation notice required for sickness or late cancellations · No refund if 15 minutes late or more; lesson forfeited · Intro 101 registration can be cancelled up to 48 hours before first class with credit to future class · No refunds or reschedules for individual Intro 101 classes · September - June for Intro 101 classes; other offerings not specifically seasonal
